newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks advance slightly amid earnings reports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks advance slightly amid earnings reports.

text.p: Wall Street stocks tacked on small gains in morning trading on Monday, optimistic about both incoming second quarter earnings reports and the broader economic picture.
"We're getting the first few earnings and on a whole, the numbers look quite good," Alfred Kugel, Stein Roe & Farnham senior investment strategist, said.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up around 16 points at 7938, after finishing up around 35 points on Friday.
The Nasdaq composite gained 11 points to 1514, while the long bond lost 8/32 to yield 6.55 percent.
